physical_definition: Keep common-mass two-branch moisture, lower mass fraction.25, humidity ratio.2,1km shear, source/sink schemes and all Earth planetary settings fixed. Integrate liquid Bolton specific saturation over pressure using64RK4 steps/layer. Surface pressure=101325exp(-terrain/8000m), same mass basis; actual smoothed surface temperature=T_col-lapse*height. Shared column_saturation_scheme pressure-lapse uses current4.414K/km environmental lapse; pressure-moist uses saturated pseudoadiabatic dry-gas approximation with constant cp/Lv. Prescribed200K isothermal stratosphere; omit water above100hPa while retaining that air in upper mass. Same profile supplies rain, ocean-equilibrium and crest capacities. For each profile use existing shared column humidity ocean_rh=.45,.60,or original.754746, all declared before new Earth results. These effective column humidities are not measured surface RH or vertical temperature states. No humidity-profile reset beyond the pre-existing fixed two-branch ratio, no latent-heat or independent vertical-temperature claim. Quadrature error at nonsmooth tropopause checked within1e-4mm plus2e-5 relative; moisture equation/error tolerances unchanged.
scope: Fixed56-case actual coupled Earth pilot,14controls then42candidates. Same strict numerical, mass, branch-speed, rainfall, temperature, ocean and external-circulation protections. At most2 qualifiers advance full31/ocean/fine/established gates; fantasy/world qualification remains separate. No atlas climate replacement or new headline score from seven reused development regions. Supervisor stops on frozen-source change or2h ceiling; no automatic exports/Git writes.
water_budget_drying_definition: column_drying includes monsoon_drying; other_column_drying is their difference. Only disjoint terms are stacked.
